data.subject: Sharing a Useful Resourc
data.body:
Dear Arhaam,

I hope you are doing well.

I wanted to share a useful resource that I recently came across and thought
might be helpful for our work. It contains practical information and
examples that could improve our workflow and make certain tasks easier to
manage.

Please let me know if you would like me to summarize the key points or
discuss how we can apply these ideas in our current projects.

Looking forward to your thoughts.

Best regards,
Hunain
